method rounded_avg(n: int, m: int) returns (result: int)
    requires n > 0 && m > 0
    requires n <= m || (n > m && result == -1)
    ensures result == -1 ==> n > m
    ensures result != -1 ==> result == (n + m) / 2 
    ensures n <= m ==> result == (n + m) / 2
    ensures result != -1 ==> result == (n + m + (m - n + 1) % 2) / 2 // rounding to the nearest integer
    // The result in binary format will be returned as "0b" + binary representation of result
    ensures result >= 0 ==> result == ToBinary(result)
    
method ToBinary(x: int) returns (binary: string)
    requires x >= 0
    ensures binary == "0b" + BinaryRepresentation(x) // function to convert integer to binary string
